purpose: Session selection for the candidate B analysis and figures (protocol notouch-calibration-comparison-eval 1.0.0, log schema 4). Selection is by unique session_id. Labels are recorded exactly as in metadata.json and are not renamed.
selection_rule: Decided from metadata.json, SHA256SUMS, the export inventory and the import result only, before any metric was computed: include every candidate B (calibration_b_three_pass_positions) session that is complete (final_state complete, 3/3 blocks, 96/96 presentations), finalized with verified device checksums and recorded in blind_measurement mode from a clean build. Accuracy, availability and verdicts play no part in selection. Official status is not changed by selection: the analyzer applies the protocol's unchanged rule and every report states it.
